name: dsfd_vm_direct_scatter_b8_native_cb5-hb2o5-COMMIT
purpose: Composed-budget native re-close of the direct-write scatter: native pin audit launch<=220/capture<=190 with exact/mutant benches; same RTL/pins/outline/2 stages

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_vm_static_scatter_b8_out_B8 #(.PIPE(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_vm_static_scatter_b8_out.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_vm_direct_write_native_profiles.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_vm_static_write_capture128.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_direct_scatter_b8_native_cb5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_direct_scatter_b8_native_cb5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: cb5 = cb4 (PIPE=1) with the fixed sender hold stage sized up HB1 -> HB2 on the outputs. cb4 b8 routed FF -14.77 = output ports only (in->reg +36.88, reg->reg +17.91); the same kit closed b0/b16/b24 at FF +4.3..+6.4. Launch headroom measured on the closed cb4/cb4b views: native launch 148.9 ps vs 220 (b24). Same RTL/pins/outline/root.

reroute_reason.fix: fixed output hold stage HB1 -> HB2 within the measured 70 ps launch headroom; PIPE=1 RTL differs from closed cb3/nativepin views
